title: Case: Merchant asks for the carrier trace reference on a grinder with no scan for six days
context: An espresso grinder left the carrier's hub and has had no scan since. The recipient has asked the merchant for a replacement, and the merchant wants to know where the carrier's trace stands before it decides.
initial_request: Quick one. Customer on TG-3382 tells us you have a trace open with Thistlecombe Arc on DL-5867. Can you confirm that's right and send us the trace ref so we can park her replacement request until it reports? I need to note the file today.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Thistlecombe Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-5867 (TG-3382, espresso grinder, one carton): last scan is outbound from Hollin Reach hub, 2028-03-25 21:14 UTC. No arrival scan anywhere since. No trace is open on it. We open a trace when we receive a request that quotes the last scan; email comes straight to us. A trace gets a reference beginning TR.
Route plan for depot WX-9 published for Wednesday. 28 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Tracking has said in transit for five days. Where is it?
My parcel DL-57761 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
DL-29429 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

events.to: Parcel trace team, Thistlecombe Arc Logistics
events.body: Please open a trace on DL-5867 (TG-3382, espresso grinder). Last scan: outbound Hollin Reach hub, 2028-03-25 21:14 UTC. No arrival scan since. Please send the trace reference.

Thanks,
Greer
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
I have asked the carrier's trace team to open a trace on DL-5867. I can't tell you where the parcel is yet. I will update you when they respond.
Saw a DL-5867 ticket land in the general pile. Nothing by that number has been through our inbound here. Can't do anything with it, we're not trace.

events.from: Depot work queue, Thistlecombe Arc Logistics
events.body: Ticket DWQ-6545 (DL-5867) was closed automatically. Reason: no depot custody scan exists for this shipment, and tickets without a custody scan close after 12 hours. The ticket was not assigned to a team. No trace was opened.
Any news from the trace? I've asked Heronwick to just send another one in the meantime.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Thistlecombe Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the trace team by email to open a trace on DL-5867 quoting the last scan (outbound Hollin Reach hub, 2028-03-25 21:14 UTC) and to send the TR reference, noting the queue ticket was auto-closed without a trace.

Tell the merchant that no trace is open on DL-5867 and there is no reference to give: the queue ticket closed without one and the request is being re-sent to the Parcel trace team by email; the replacement decision stays with the merchant.

must: Makes clear that no trace is open on DL-5867 yet (the earlier queue ticket closed without one)
Names Email to the Parcel trace team as the route for the trace request: sends the request there, or tells the merchant it is being re-sent there
Gives the last scan as outbound from Hollin Reach hub on 25 March
Treats the TR reference as not yet existing: asks the trace team to send it, or tells the merchant there is none to give yet
must_not: Confirm to the merchant or the recipient that a trace is open on DL-5867
Give or invent a trace reference, or pass off ticket DWQ-6545 as one
Raise the request again in the Depot work queue
State that the parcel is lost, or tell the merchant to authorise or withhold the replacement
Promise the recipient a replacement or a delivery date
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please open a trace on DL-5867 (Heronwick Goods order TG-3382, espresso grinder, one carton). Last scan: outbound from Hollin Reach hub, 2028-03-25 21:14 UTC. There has been no arrival scan since, and the destination depot says it has not been through their inbound. This desk raised the request in the Depot work queue on 2028-03-30 (ticket DWQ-6545), but that ticket was closed automatically without reaching you, so no trace exists yet. Please send the TR reference once it is open. The merchant's replacement team is waiting on it to decide how to handle the customer's replacement request.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-203: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
